description: Valkey-owned expedition and active-enemy buffers with revision-checked combat continuation, immutable terminal settlement snapshots, movement admission, run-qualified cleanup, receipt-protected in-run defeat credits and SQL reward/history settlement (C1, C2).

lock_sequence.note: Lock all participating expedition member characters in ascending ID order before claiming the run and applying rewards.

lock_sequence.mode: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE via shared post-battle settlement

lock_sequence.note: Escape only: clears each member's meal flag after the character and inventory writes.

transaction_boundaries.note: The run-ID history INSERT claims settlement once after the character lock; record updates, deletion of the run's credit receipts and owner/run-qualified SQL fallback deletion share that transaction. Live-store/member cleanup runs separately after commit.

lock_sequence.note: Lock every credited character in ascending ID order before reading the run's settlement claim and inserting receipts.

lock_sequence.mode: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE via shared post-battle settlement

lock_sequence.note: Recruitment from the killer's defeat facts, within box capacity.

transaction_boundaries.note: Receipts in dungeon_defeat_credits (unique per run and credit ID) are inserted after the character locks; only newly receipted credits reach battle.Service.ApplyPostBattleResult in the same transaction. A run already claimed in dungeon_expedition_history settles nothing. Dungeon acknowledges the credits in Valkey after commit.
